sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9178 of 2023

Applicant :- Ram Chander Alias Chande
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. (Home), Govt. U.P. Lucknow
Counsel for Applicant :- Ramakar Shukla

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The FIR in question was lodged through an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. alleging that on 24.07.2022 at about 9 PM when the victim was lying with her child aged about 2 years and her father and mother were sleeping outside the home, the applicant came and committed the offence in question.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argues that the FIR in question was lodged after about four months of the incident through an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C.
He further draws my attention to the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., wherein the date of the incident was narrated as 22.07.2022.
He further argues that there is a land dispute going on in between the family members for which an altercation had taken place and a challani report under Section 151, 107, 116 Cr.P.C., was prepared.
The said report is on record and is dated 29.07.2022.
It is argued that no allegation with regard to commission of the offence in question are mentioned in the said challani report.

He argues that the medical report also does not corroborate the allegation and thus, except for an application and the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., which are also at variance, there is no prima-facie evidence against the applicant.
The applicant is in custody since 24.03.2023 and has no criminal antecedent.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the family dispute in between the parties, prima-facie there being no mention of the commission of the offence in question in the said challani report, there being a discrepancy in the contents of the FIR as well as in the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., with regard to the alleged date of incident, and the fact that there is no prima-facie evidence to corroborate the allegation, the applicant who is in custody since 24.03.2023 and has no criminal antecedent, is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Ram Chander @ Chande be released on bail in FIR No.26 of 2023, under Section 376, 504, 506 IPC, P.S. Kurwar, District Sultanpur on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
